blind.description: A pair of traditional dome-shaped coiled straw skep beehives resting on a rustic low wooden bench. The bench has a natural brown wood-grain plank top supported by four green-painted wooden legs connected with side stretchers. Each skep is golden-yellow straw with distinct horizontal coils, a small arched entry hole near the bottom, and a flat round grey stone resting on top. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures. No floating, melted, or detached elements.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden tabletop containing two circular straw beehive domes side-by-side, each capped with a round grey stone at the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 4 feet long and 1.8 feet wide.
